rp-berry-04.front: Fruits that hang on into winter?
rp-berry-04.back: Snowberry, rose hips, kinnikinnick, high bush cranberry.

rp-berry-05.front: Why does fruit ripen in a wave?
rp-berry-05.back: Warm, low, sunny sites ripen first; high and shady sites later.
